context: Classify the supplied claim using exactly {"claim_verified":true|false,"classification":"verified|partial|unverified|agent_reported"}. Decide the exact claim, not a weaker proxy.

cases.input: A synthetic JSON compression benchmark saved 69.4% input tokens in three requests. The claim is: our full coding team now uses 69.4% fewer tokens.
An agent's PR text says 78 tests passed. Nobody collected the runner output or independently checked it. The claim is: 78 tests independently verified passing.
The evaluator captured exit 0 and all 18 exact answer assertions passed. The claim is: these 18 answer checks passed in this bounded benchmark.
The first orchestrator run failed at mutation. A human retried that stage and resumed reviewers successfully. The claim is: a clean unattended end-to-end run succeeded.
A timed mutation run killed 20 mutants before exit 124; the total mutant count is unknown. The claim is: partial progress of 20 killed mutants was observed, but a complete score is unavailable.
A cross-tenant clone was attempted in an actual sandbox and the evaluator asserted the resulting workspace phase was Failed. The claim is: this particular cross-tenant clone was refused.
